title: Count Simple Paths
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq M \leq \min \left(2 \times 10^5, \frac{N(N-1)}{2}\right); 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; The given graph is simple.; The degree of each vertex in the given graph is at most 10.; All values in the input are integers.
